### 1 of 1. 2 unused import lines in src/widgets bring in names nothing uses

### What was found
Two import lines (lines that pull a name in from another file) bring in a name that the file never uses:

- src/widgets/render.ts, line 2
- src/widgets/format.ts, line 3

No other card touches these two files.

### Why it matters
The housekeeping base rules, in their Code section, say to remove imports, variables and modules that nothing uses. Unused lines like these make readers think the file depends on something it does not.

### What happens if you accept
Both lines are deleted and nothing else changes. You get one new pull request against the default branch. Undoing it means reverting one commit. No test command comes with this check.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged. [recommended]
2. [ ] Ticket - file one ticket listing them and change nothing now
3. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
